Only methods declared in sugar-readline/src, or inherited from a parent declared there, are listed. A type that extends a class outside that tree, such as \RuntimeException, does not show the methods of that class.

SugarCraft\Readline

Ansi final class

Tiny ANSI helper. Wraps text in \x1b[<codes>m...\x1b[0m. Empty codes is a no-op so callers can pass a configurable style.

MethodSummary
static wrap(string $text, string $codes): string
static sanitize(string $text): stringStrip C0 control bytes from text before ANSI emission.
static sanitizeForSingleLine(string $text): stringSingle-line posture: like sanitize() but LF is stripped too — a pasted newline must not forge a submit or a multi-line value in a one-line prompt. TAB survives (completion wants it readable).

HasNotice trait

The transient notice row (findings 033/084): a dim one-line announce for refusals and silent policy events — the FIFO un-mark at the selection cap, Ctrl+R over an empty history, a newline the line limit refuses — that would otherwise happen with zero feedback. The notice lives exactly one input beat: every public key funnel clears it before dispatch, so the refusing arm may set a fresh one on the same clone chain and the next key erases it.

FileHistory final class

File-persisted history store.

MethodSummary
__construct(string $filePath, int $maxHistory = 0, string $tempDir = '', bool $deferWrites = false)
static tryOpen(string $filePath, int $maxHistory = 0, string $tempDir = '', bool $deferWrites = false): ?selfGraceful-degradation entry point for host startup (finding 020).
path(): stringThe path this history file was opened over. Lets a host report WHERE persistence failed (after a null tryOpen) or where a loaded session's history actually lives, without catching and parsing an exception message out of a constructor call.
__destruct()
__clone()
push(string $line): voidAppend $line to the history and update the in-memory state.
setMaxHistory(int $limit): selfSet the retained-entry cap and honor it on DISK immediately when the new bound can shrink the persisted view (finding 065 — the inherited memory-only trim let another process's next read resurrect entries the live session had just discarded, because the file is the shared truth and a cap must reach it at set time, not at next push time).
flush(): voidPersist any queued entries in a single atomic write.
clear(): voidClear all entries from both in-memory history and the persistence file. Uses an atomic write (temp + rename), so a reader never observes a half-erased file. The empty rewrite carries no content bytes to fsync, so a kernel crash can still resurrect the previous entries — as on the other paths (finding 064), the guarantee is against torn reads, not against the loss of the swap itself.
withMaxHistory(int $limit): selfBC forwarder for the pre-rename immutable spelling.

entries(): arrayStorage-order read view: newest first (index 0 = most recent push).

HistoryInterface interface

Contracts for readline history navigation.

MethodSummary
push(string $line): voidAdd a line to history if it is non-empty and differs from the last entry.
previous(): ?stringReturn the previous history entry and advance the navigation position. Returns null when there is no previous entry.
next(): ?stringReturn the next history entry and advance the navigation position. Returns null when there is no next entry (we are at the "live" buffer).
reset(): voidReset the navigation position to "live" (no entry selected, position = -1).
clear(): voidClear all history entries.
entries(): arrayEvery retained entry in storage order: newest first (index 0 is the most recent push — the same order self::previous() walks).
count(): intNumber of retained entries — the length of self::entries().
search(string $query, int $fromIndex, SearchDirection|int $direction): ?SearchHitIncrementally search history for an entry containing $query.
